principle: Anything capable of changing the declared experiment must be either a frozen packet member or a realized object admitted by a frozen prospective rule.

environment.working_directory: isolated benchmark workspace rooted at explicit repo_root
environment.note: The authorized first-endpoint runner reads no environment variable as scientific input. External future grounding is completed before this runner and is governed separately by G and FUTURE_CONSEQUENCE_GROUNDING_CONTRACT.

allowed_post_freeze_inputs: the authorization certificate bound to the frozen packet and freeze anchor
the one realized record admitted by the frozen G/common-cause chain

future_executable.selection: exact-version official @biomejs/cli-linux-x64 artifact resolved by FUTURE_EXECUTION_ARTIFACT_CONTRACT
future_executable.integrity_failure: NOT_IDENTIFIED under the selected event; no substitution

configuration_identity.packet_member_identity: Git blob SHA-1 computed over loaded bytes must equal the manifest member blob
configuration_identity.packet_root_identity: canonical packet-manifest SHA-256 must equal the authorization certificate
configuration_identity.execution_root_identity: canonical execution-required member-set SHA-256 must equal the authorization certificate
configuration_identity.freeze_anchor_identity: certificate must bind the exact content-addressed freeze anchor that links packet bytes to the Git freeze commit/tree and timestamp verified during I adjudication

preflight: validate packet bytes and freeze anchor
load exactly every execution-root member and no other member
validate exact realized-record schema and frozen parent identity
authorized_runner.treatment_materialization: runner derives both A and B matrices itself from frozen GAMMA_A/GAMMA_B plus the frozen common semantic coordinate map
authorized_runner.future_input: runner accepts only the common realized 12-surface grounding table; no arm-specific future object
authorized_runner.paired_evaluation: same FINAL_POSTGATE_RUNTIME.evaluate_first_endpoint code path for A and B
authorized_runner.logical_schedule_check: A/B materialization traces and first-endpoint runtime traces must be exactly equal
authorized_runner.result_identity: canonical paired result is SHA-256 content-addressed and binds packet, certificate, freeze, realized grounding envelope, runtime fingerprint, and both arm component outputs
authorized_runner.result_scope: first endpoint only; no CCA/CARS/final adaptation claim

provenance_threat_model.trusted_external_history: GitHub commit/tree/blob identity as observed and recorded at predicate-I adjudication
not_claimed: cryptographic defense against a malicious repository administrator rewriting all remote history
SHA-1 collision resistance beyond Git repository identity assumptions
provenance_threat_model.goal: prevent accidental, post-hoc, mixed-lineage, stale-certificate, undeclared-control, and wrong-runtime drift in the confirmatory workflow

fail_closed: Any undeclared dependency, schema extension, runtime mismatch, member mismatch, or identity mismatch rejects execution; no statistical compensation, repair, or fallback is permitted inside the confirmatory lineage.
